![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Pass the `diagnostics` array to `registryIndex` and `cropRiskIndex` so that any malformed rows detected during indexing are recorded as validation failures.

```suggestion
function buildInventoryRows({ sourceRows, registryRows, cropRiskRows, paths, generatedAt, diagnostics }) {
  const registryBySourcePdf = registryIndex(registryRows, diagnostics);
  const cropBySourceAndQuestion = cropRiskIndex(cropRiskRows, diagnostics);
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When validating collections of data, explicitly check for and record malformed entries as structured validation failures, and skip further processing of those entries to avoid runtime property access errors.
</details>
